tools.name: discover_datasets
tools.description: Discover reusable real-data catalogs available to this GeoHarness deployment. This returns data capabilities only; it does not prescribe a workflow.

step_id.description: Optional stable Task Graph step id. Omit to use the Harness tool-call id.

tools.name: inspect_dataset
tools.description: Inspect one registered vector layer: feature count, geometry, CRS, fields, missing values, validity, bounds and area summary.

step_id.description: Optional stable Task Graph step id. Omit to use the Harness tool-call id.

tools.name: list_layers
tools.description: List canonical layers in this Agent workspace. Pass a dataset_id to load that reusable real-data catalog before analysis.

dataset_id.description: Optional Dataset catalog to activate and load.

step_id.description: Optional stable Task Graph step id. Omit to use the Harness tool-call id.

tools.name: transform_crs
tools.description: Transform a registered vector layer to a target CRS and register the derived layer.

step_id.description: Optional stable Task Graph step id. Omit to use the Harness tool-call id.

tools.name: create_buffer
tools.description: Create a positive metric buffer around a layer and register it with lineage.

step_id.description: Optional stable Task Graph step id. Omit to use the Harness tool-call id.

tools.name: spatial_filter
tools.description: Select features by attribute equality and/or a spatial predicate against a mask layer.

step_id.description: Optional stable Task Graph step id. Omit to use the Harness tool-call id.

tools.name: spatial_join
tools.description: Join right-layer attributes onto left-layer features using an explicit spatial predicate.

step_id.description: Optional stable Task Graph step id. Omit to use the Harness tool-call id.

tools.name: clip_layer
tools.description: Clip an input vector layer to another registered mask layer.

step_id.description: Optional stable Task Graph step id. Omit to use the Harness tool-call id.

tools.name: aggregate_by_region
tools.description: Aggregate feature count and area sum by a region field, returning a derived region statistics layer.

step_id.description: Optional stable Task Graph step id. Omit to use the Harness tool-call id.

tools.name: calculate_geometry
tools.description: Calculate metric area and length fields for every feature and register the derived layer.

step_id.description: Optional stable Task Graph step id. Omit to use the Harness tool-call id.

tools.name: nearest_features
tools.description: Find the nearest target feature for every input feature and record metric distance.

step_id.description: Optional stable Task Graph step id. Omit to use the Harness tool-call id.

tools.name: analyze_distribution
tools.description: Summarize selected numeric or categorical fields without creating a derived layer.

step_id.description: Optional stable Task Graph step id. Omit to use the Harness tool-call id.

tools.name: export_layer
tools.description: Export a registered layer to a workspace-local GeoJSON, GeoPackage or CSV file.

step_id.description: Optional stable Task Graph step id. Omit to use the Harness tool-call id.
